mods.name: Animal Weights

releases.notes:
Initial release of **Animal Weights** for NeoForge.

A husbandry mechanic for vanilla farm animals: cows, pigs, sheep, chickens, rabbits, and mooshrooms each carry an integer **weight** from 0 to 8 that responds to how well they're kept. Weight scales the meat / leather / XP they drop when killed.

## Requirements
- Minecraft 26.1.x
- NeoForge 26.1.x (built against 26.1.2.43-beta)

## Install
Drop `animal-weights-0.1.0.jar` into your `mods/` folder. Server-side mechanic — only the host needs the mod, though connected clients need it to see Slowness on sick animals.

## What it does
Each in-game day at dawn, every target-species adult is evaluated against four conditions (light, water, grazing, stretching). 4 → +1 weight, 3 → 0, 2 → −1, 0–1 → −2. Drops at weight 8 are +11 over vanilla; at weight 0 (sick) the mob has Slowness, can't breed, and drops half as much.

See the [README](https://github.com/joseph-osullivan/animal-weights#readme) for the full mechanic spec.

## Concept
Original idea by [u/Axoladdy on Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/Minecraft/comments/1te0m69/animal_weights_a_simple_mechanic_to_encourage/).
